free.name: Free
free.description: Every local feature, plus remote access to up to 3 registered machines through the managed relay. Local terminal multiplexing and self-hosted relays stay free under the Ferryx License, a source-available license.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For individual developers and power users managing multiple cloud instances, workstations, and local machines.

team.name: Team
team.launch_price_note: Launch price. It moves to the list price once team administration features ship; teams that subscribe at the launch price are told in advance.
team.description: For companies and teams collaborating across fleets of development servers and build runners with unified pooled capacity.

business.name: Business
business.description: For organizations that need SSO, audit logs, and agent policy controls. Not priced yet: join the waitlist to become a design partner.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: On-premises account and hub servers, SCIM, invoicing, and an SLA. Priced by quote.

policies.local_and_selfhosted: Local terminal multiplexing, direct LAN connections, and self-hosted relays (FERRYX_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=selfhost) are perpetually free with no license keys or machine limits required.
policies.enrollment_cap: New machine enrollment is blocked immediately when registered machines reach plan capacity (PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED).
policies.grace_period_policy: 7-day grace period for existing accounts entering overdue or over-capacity state before all account-based remote connections (relay and direct streams) are fully stopped at the grace deadline. Local and LAN terminal access is never interrupted.
